# B8.6 comparison results

**Empty on purpose.** No comparison has been run. FR-M-03 (`model-bench`) is Release 4 work.
Nothing in this repository reports the quality, review time or cost of any model on B8.6.

Results go here only from a real run on a fixed rubric (`../rubric.yaml` with `frozen: true`)
and reviewed expected outputs. Each run records the data set version, the providers and models,
the prompt versions, the date, and who reviewed (design §11.2).
